review_response_tasks.stem: The manager asked the witness to ____ the colour and model of the car, not guess who owned it.
review_response_tasks.rationale: describe：描述colour/model用describe；consume消耗/purchase买/forgive原谅不承该信息要求。

review_response_tasks.stem: The two neighbours met at the station ____; neither knew the other was travelling that day.
review_response_tasks.rationale: by chance：双方未知出行偶遇bychance；onpurpose故意反，incharge负责/atrisk危险无对应偶遇方式。

review_response_tasks.stem: Instead of shouting, he walked outside to ____ and returned when he felt calm.
review_response_tasks.rationale: cool down：冷静后返cooldown；炫耀/破门/赠奖不说明平复情绪。

review_response_tasks.stem: The tutor encouraged us to ____ our answers against the text before handing them in.
review_response_tasks.rationale: check：againsttext核答案check；invent编造/ignore无视反，owe欠不构成核对。

review_response_tasks.stem: The portable lamp is easy to carry. “Portable” means ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: movable：portable可携movable；invisible不可见/permanent永久/fragile易碎不是携带属性同义。

review_response_tasks.stem: The warm afternoon ended with a short ____ of rain, not a long storm.
review_response_tasks.rationale: shower：短阵雨shower；drought干旱反，landscape景/horizon地平线不是降水事件。

review_response_tasks.stem: The appeal asked residents to ____ books they no longer needed to the free reading room.
review_response_tasks.rationale: donate：将不用书捐免费阅览donate；consume消耗/forbid禁止/owe欠不表无偿给。

review_response_tasks.stem: The report calls the change “minor”, meaning it is ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: small：minor小small；enormous巨大反，permanent持续/inevitable必然不是程度同义。

review_response_tasks.stem: The new lock will ____ access by people without the correct key.
review_response_tasks.rationale: restrict：无钥锁限制restrict；encourage鼓励相反，celebrate庆/imitate仿不表控制进入。

review_response_tasks.stem: The volunteers sorted the reusable paper to ____ it from ordinary rubbish.
review_response_tasks.rationale: separate：separateAfromB分离；borrow借/deserve应得/accuse控告不表分类分开。

review_response_tasks.stem: In the 1975 story, she promised that she ____ write again before the summer ended.
review_response_tasks.rationale: would：过去promised所引未来wouldwrite；has/had需written，is不能接write。

review_response_tasks.stem: They reached a point ____ neither side was willing to continue the argument.
review_response_tasks.rationale: where：point抽象阶段用where，从句无缺名词成分；which缺介词，whose需名词，whom人宾格不合。

review_response_tasks.stem: The boxes ____ against the wall ____ to the theatre group.
review_response_tasks.rationale: standing; belong：standing非限定修饰boxes，belong作复数谓语；stood;belonging无限定，stand;belong两谓语无连接，standing;belonging无限定。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our neighbourhood ____ three new bus stops since the route changed.
review_response_tasks.rationale: has gained：since完成、neighbourhood单数hasgained；gain数错，gaining非限定，willgained结构错。

review_response_tasks.stem: The plan ____ at yesterday’s meeting is on the website now.
review_response_tasks.rationale: approved：plan被approved作后置定语；approving主动，approves限定，toapproving错构。

review_response_tasks.stem: The empty envelope is in the bin, so someone ____ it before the parcel was sent.
review_response_tasks.rationale: must have opened：过去已打开后寄，musthaveopened回推；mustopen现在义务，willopen未来，mayopening错。

review_response_tasks.stem: Unless ____ from the rain, the paper will become wet, ____ the writing unreadable.
review_response_tasks.rationale: protected; leaving：paper被保护protected省略，后leaving结果；protecting主动不合，protect原形/tobare非该省略被动，后left/leaves/leave不作结果分词。

review_response_tasks.stem: Two of the windows ____ already been replaced.
review_response_tasks.rationale: have：two复数havebeen；has数错，was/is不接been作完成。

review_response_tasks.stem: The visitor paused ____ a photograph of the doorway.
review_response_tasks.rationale: to take：停下来为了拍totake；takes/took非目的，totaking不定式后原形要求错。

review_response_tasks.stem: ____ the instructions twice, Mira helped the new members, ____ were still unsure where to begin.
review_response_tasks.rationale: Having read; who：先读两次再帮助Havingread，members主语who；Read被动不合，which物，whom宾格、whose需名词。

student_passage: 各题语境独立。同一选项中有分号时，依次回填该题两个空，但只作答一次。
